description: Every ref value points at a row that exists in the referenced pool.
cmd: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && node scripts/datagen.mjs --spec templates/spec.example.json --seed 5 --rows 10 --out "$tmp/users.json" >/dev/null && node scripts/datagen.mjs --spec evals/fixtures/orders.spec.json --seed 5 --rows 40 --ref "users.id=$tmp/users.json" --out "$tmp/orders.json" >/dev/null && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const ids=new Set(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8')).map(u=>u.id));const orphans=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8')).filter(o=>!ids.has(o.user_id));if(orphans.length){console.error('orphans: '+orphans.length);process.exit(1)}console.log('referential integrity ok')" "$tmp/users.json" "$tmp/orders.json" && rm -rf "$tmp"
provenance: hard rule: generated child rows must not orphan unless the test asked for orphans
